package worker

import "github.com/Suhaibinator/Next.go/internal/offlinejson"

const recoveredDisableCommand = "disable-recovered"
const recoveredDisableEvent = "message-disable-recovered"
const maxRecoveredSourceBytes = 2048

// This is native adapter context, not a field in the authored command. Only
// the private browser dispatch kind can reach the recovered entry point.
type recoveredDisableSource struct {
	URL string `json:"url"`
	ID  string `json:"id"`
}

func decodeRecoveredDisableSource(raw string) (recoveredDisableSource, error) {
	var source recoveredDisableSource
	if len(raw) == 0 || len(raw) > maxRecoveredSourceBytes || offlinejson.Decode([]byte(raw), &source) != nil || source.URL == "" || !validClientID(source.ID) {
		return recoveredDisableSource{}, offlinejson.ErrInvalid
	}
	return source, nil
}

func (e *Engine) recoveredDisable(command Command, rawSource string) Status {
	source, err := decodeRecoveredDisableSource(rawSource)
	if err != nil {
		result := e.baseStatus(command.RequestID)
		result.Error = "invalid-message"
		return result
	}
	return e.message(command, source.URL, &source)
}

// matchAll(false) and matchAll(true) are sequential native reads. Require a
// self-consistent complete pair and refuse a racing/incomplete pair rather than
// pretending they form an atomic browser snapshot.
func recoveredDisableClients(clients ioReply, sender string) string {
	if !validClientID(sender) || clients.Controlled < 0 || clients.Controlled != len(clients.ClientIDs) || len(clients.VisibleIDs) > 256 {
		return "clients-unavailable"
	}
	if clients.Controlled > 4 {
		return "client-capacity"
	}
	visible := make(map[string]bool, len(clients.VisibleIDs))
	for _, id := range clients.VisibleIDs {
		if !validClientID(id) || visible[id] {
			return "clients-unavailable"
		}
		visible[id] = true
	}
	controlled := make(map[string]bool, len(clients.ClientIDs))
	for _, id := range clients.ClientIDs {
		if !validClientID(id) || controlled[id] || !visible[id] {
			return "clients-unavailable"
		}
		controlled[id] = true
	}
	if !controlled[sender] || !visible[sender] {
		return "sender-uncontrolled"
	}
	return ""
}
